population.measurement: Mid-year total resident population; latest published observations retain their own year.

gdp.measurement: Gross domestic product at purchaser prices, in current US dollars. Exchange rates and reporting years affect comparisons.

perCapita.measurement: GDP divided by mid-year population, in current US dollars; this is not household income or purchasing-power adjusted.

iq.source: International IQ Test 2025, compiled by World Population Review
iq.measurement: These are self-selected online test averages, not a measure of a population's innate ability. Education, nutrition, language, internet access, test familiarity and sample composition all affect cross-country comparisons.
